extracted.intended_audience: Federal agency officials and component managers responsible for implementing OMB Circular A-120 (consulting services) and preparing the agency's questionnaire response
extracted.subtask_description: A component-level questionnaire and instructions for agencies to report how they implement OMB Circular A-120 (consulting services), including documentation, data on competitive vs noncompetitive awards, internal controls, definitions, and any audits/evaluations. Responses are used by an interagency working group to assess implementation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respondent identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Who is answering the following questions on Circular A-120? Name, Title, Telephone number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide contact information for the person completing the questionnaire for follow-up.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency official responsible for implementing A-120
rubrics_metrics.description: Who is the agency official responsible for implementing A-120? Name, Title, Telephone number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify the official with responsibility for the agency's implementation of the circular.

rubrics_metrics.name: Existence of agency regulations or internal guidelines for arranging consulting services
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the agency have regulations or internal guidelines to be followed in arranging for consulting services? (No; Yes, agency internal guidelines — attach copy; Yes, codified regulations — provide CFR cite.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If yes, attach a copy of internal guidelines or provide the CFR citation. Follow the skip instructions (e.g., if No, skip to next question).

rubrics_metrics.name: Whether agency regulations supplement the government-wide FAR
rubrics_metrics.description: Are these regulations a supplement to the government-wide FAR? (Yes / No)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate explicitly whether agency regulations augment or supplement the Federal Acquisition Regulation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of data on number of noncompetitively-awarded consulting contracts
rubrics_metrics.description: Are data available on the number of noncompetitively-awarded consulting contracts? (No / Yes)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If No, follow skip instructions. If Yes, be prepared to supply counts and supporting documentation where requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percent noncompetitive awards (historical and current)
rubrics_metrics.description: What percent of consulting contracts were/are noncompetitive? Provide percent 5 years ago (or 'don't know') and percent now.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the requested percentages for the immediate past fiscal year(s) and comparable historical data where available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Controls to ensure maximum practicable competitive awards
rubrics_metrics.description: Are there controls to ensure that the maximum number practicable of consulting contracts are awarded competitively? (No / Yes — in codified regulations (provide CFR cite) / Yes — in agency internal directives/guidelines (attach copy) / Yes — in other ways (specify))
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If Yes, describe where the controls are documented and attach supporting documentation as requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of internal controls used for consulting award decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: What do these controls include? (check all that apply: Usual clearances/sign-offs; Special clearances/sign-offs; Approval by a more senior level official than for competitive awards; Other — specify.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select applicable control types and specify any other mechanisms. Provide examples or references to clearance/approval procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting consulting appointments data to OPM Central Personnel Data File
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the agency make sure that appropriate data on consulting services are provided to OPM's Central Personnel Data File (for personnel appointments)? (Yes / No)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate whether and how consulting personnel appointment data are reported to OPM.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting contracting data to the Federal Procurement Data System
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the agency make sure that appropriate data on consulting services are provided to the Federal Procurement Data System (for contracts)? (Yes / No)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate processes for reporting consulting contract data into FPDS and attach relevant documentation if requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting advisory committee data to GSA under interim regulations
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the agency make sure that appropriate data on consulting services are provided to GSA in accordance with GSA interim regulations on Advisory committees? (Yes / No)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Address compliance with GSA reporting requirements where advisory committees are involved; attach supporting materials if available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Centralization of consulting services data
rubrics_metrics.description: Are the data provided in OPM, FPDS, and GSA kept centrally? (No — skip to question f / Yes — Where? provide building and room number.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If data are centralized, state the physical or organizational location and describe the central repository or custodian.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mutual exclusivity of reported data to avoid duplication
rubrics_metrics.description: Are the data provided in OPM, FPDS, and GSA mutually exclusive to ensure that the agency's total number of consultants is accurate and non-duplicative? (Yes / No — please explain any duplication.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain whether datasets overlap, how duplication is detected/handled, and any reconciliation processes used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency definition and scope of 'consultants' under A-120
rubrics_metrics.description: Who is included in the agency's definition of consultants? Describe the scope of the agency's interpretation of A-120 and attach any written material on this point.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the agency's working definition, examples of included/excluded positions, and any written interpretations or policy statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Existence of GAO or agency IG evaluations regarding A-120 performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Are there any GAO or agency IG evaluations of agency performance under A-120? (Yes — please attach a copy / No)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach copies of any audits or evaluations; if none exist, state that fact. These will be used by the working group for analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attach copies of requested agency documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach two copies of all relevant agency documentation to your response where documentation is requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide two physical copies of requested documents with the questionnaire to facilitate consolidation and review by the working group.

rubrics_metrics.name: Component-level response guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: One reply from each agency for each circular is preferred; however, if significant variations exist among large operating components, submit separate replies clearly identified to indicate the components to which they refer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When preparing consolidated responses for departments with diverse components (e.g., DOD, DHHS), either provide one consolidated reply or separate component replies as appropriate; clearly label component-specific submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Temporal scope of responses (timeframe)
rubrics_metrics.description: In replying to individual questions, assume responses relate to current practices and the immediate past fiscal year (FY 1985) unless there is an indication to the contrary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide data and descriptions that reflect the current state and FY1985 activity; where GAO/IG evaluations exist, supply those evaluations even if they cover different timeframes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deadline and submission routing
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the consolidated questionnaire response by the stated deadline and send replies to the designated OMB/working group contact (specific room/office and contact names/phone numbers given).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow routing instructions (identify recipient office and contact), meet the submission deadline (dates provided in memos), and direct questions to the listed contacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunity to provide additional comments on implementation factors
rubrics_metrics.description: If you wish to submit comments on any additional factors not covered in the questionnaire that affect your ability to implement the circulars satisfactorily, please do so along with the completed questionnaire.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include narrative comments about constraints, unique circumstances, or implementation challenges that are not captured by the questionnaire items.
